scenarios.pageSubtitle: Concrete problems on board, on route and on the worksite
scenarios.ctaDesc: Tell us about it. We'll help you configure the exact system you need.
scenarios.desc: Nautic Talk was built around concrete problems on board, on route and on the worksite. If any of these sound familiar, there's a system for you.
scenarios.card1Problem: You're on deck preparing the anchor. The skipper is in the wheelhouse. You can see each other, but you can't hear each other. Gloved hand signs, every gesture misread.
scenarios.card1Solution: With Nautic Talk Duo, both of you talk and listen at the same time. Hands free, clean anchoring.
scenarios.card2Problem: Docking in a crosswind. Engine idling, line to starboard, skipper at the helm. Shouting doesn't reach the wheelhouse.
scenarios.card2Solution: Trio coordinates three stations at once: bridge, bow and stern. The maneuver flows without raising a voice.
scenarios.card3Problem: Peloton at 40 km/h. Pothole ahead, car behind. Raising your hand to signal means letting go of the handlebars.
scenarios.card3Solution: Module clips onto your helmet. Full-duplex audio against the wind. Warn the group without letting go of the brakes.
scenarios.card4Problem: The crane operator can't see around the corner. You're on the ground with the load and the gearbox. Gloved signals, every misunderstanding is a risk.
scenarios.card4Solution: Full-duplex between operator and ground crew. No ambiguity, no shouting, no dropped loads.
scenarios.card5Problem: 3 am watch. Radar, chart and horizon. The rest of the crew is resting below. A change in the lights, you have to decide, without waking anyone unless needed.
scenarios.card5Solution: Nautic Talk links bridge to bunk without raising a voice. Whisper and it still comes through clear.
scenarios.card6Problem: Stage, FOH and backstage. The sound engineer gets fragments from three different radios, none of them complete. "Over", "say again", "over".
scenarios.card6Solution: Trio for production crews: three voices, one conversation. No 'over', no waiting.

sistema.subtitle: Professional Bluetooth intercommunication
sistema.manifestoQuote2: Three worlds. Nautic Talk is the communication system that works where others get complicated, power on, talk, keep working.
sistema.manifestoAuthor: How we think about professional communication
sistema.modelsDesc: Trio for groups of up to 3 people. Duo for pairs of workers. Same audio, same resistance, same battery life, pick based on your team size.
sistema.emptyModels: Connect your Shopify store to see the Trio and Duo models.
sistema.stepsDesc: No cable pairing, no PIN codes, no apps. The system comes pre-configured from the factory for your team.
sistema.step1Desc: Press the power button on each module. The devices recognise each other automatically since they're pre-paired at the factory.
sistema.step2Desc: The Bluetooth connection establishes itself. No manual pairing, no phone-fiddling, nothing to set up on a screen.
sistema.step3Desc: Full-duplex audio: everyone talks and listens at once, like a real conversation. No push-to-talk, no turns, no interruptions.
sistema.techDesc: Technical specifications common to all Nautic Talk modules. Trio and Duo share the same hardware platform.
sistema.techAudioL1: , everyone talks and listens at once
sistema.techBuildL3: Adapts to left or right ear
sistema.sectorsDesc: The same module clips onto sailing helmets, cycling helmets or safety hard hats. Swap the mount, not the system.
sistema.marineDesc: Sailing crews, yachts and work boats. Coordination between bridge, bow and stern during anchoring, mooring and navigation. Resists sea water, salt spray and extreme conditions.
sistema.cyclingDesc: Group rides, training, MTB and race pelotons. Compatible with standard cycling helmets. Clear audio at any speed thanks to the wind filter.
sistema.industrialDesc: Construction, warehouses, logistics, cranes and events. Direct integration with PPE safety helmets. Hands-free communication for team coordination in noisy environments.
sistema.modularDesc: Trio and Duo modules are the base. Mounts, helmets, headsets and accessories are added based on how and where you use the system.
sistema.modularADesc: Marine adhesives, universal clips, safety helmet mounts and magnetic mounts.
sistema.modularBDesc: Speaker headset set with ear hooks and soft pads for long-term use without chafing.
sistema.modularCDesc: ABS safety helmets with UV protection, 30 mm slots for face and ear protection.
sistema.modularDDesc: Wind covers for the microphone, replacement mounts and fixing kits for any helmet.
sistema.ctaDesc: Pick Trio or Duo based on your team size, or talk to an advisor to configure the exact system you need.
